name: snaplii-a2m-payment
description: Shop and save with Snaplii, a separate, pre-funded account with user-controlled permissions and spending limits. Claude buys gift cards across 500+ brands in Canada and the US with vouchers and up to 10% cashback, checks the Snaplii Cash balance, pays bills (Canada only) and sends P2P transfers, without seeing the user's card or bank credentials.

snaplii_api_key.title: Snaplii API key
snaplii_api_key.description: Optional. The key from the Snaplii app (More > Payment Methods > AI Payment Management > + New API Key). When set, Claude connects with it directly. Leave empty to enter the key on a secure Snaplii page when Claude connects.
